title: Surreal Misty Waterfall
description: A lone figure rows a small yellow boat across a misty lake toward a glowing pink symbol on the water. In the background, a massive waterfall flows from rocky cliffs beside a red pagoda, while a UFO-like platform hovers between mountains under a sky containing multiple moons, a sunset, and a tall communication tower on a golden hill.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape at twilight with a small yellow boat carrying a lone rower on a misty lake. A glowing pink circular symbol floats on the water near a large waterfall cascading into the lake. On the right a traditional red multi-tiered pagoda sits on a cliff. A metallic communication tower stands on a golden hill to the left. A futuristic glowing platform hovers in the sky between mountains. Multiple celestial bodies including a large red moon, smaller green and blue moons, and a setting sun fill the colorful sky. Fog fills the valley between mountains. Cracked road with a yellow No U-Turn sign in foreground.
